description: This file defines data models (structs, enums) and constants for the OpenClaw Protocol in Swift. It includes various request/response/message frame structures, error codes, agent and session parameters, and configuration schemas used for communication and control within the OpenClaw system.

classes.name: ConnectParams
classes.description: Model for connection parameters sent during handshake.

classes.name: HelloOk
classes.description: Sent as handshake response containing server features and snapshot.

classes.name: RequestFrame
classes.description: Generic structure for request messages sent over the protocol.

classes.name: ResponseFrame
classes.description: Generic structure for responses to requests, indicating success or error.

classes.name: EventFrame
classes.description: Event message structure for server-to-client notifications.

classes.name: PresenceEntry
classes.description: Represents a presence status of a device or user.

classes.name: StateVersion
classes.description: Tracks versioning for presence and health states.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: Captures the current state of presence, health, and configuration.

classes.name: AgentEvent
classes.description: Structure for agent-related events with associated data.

classes.name: SendParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending a message or command.

classes.name: AgentParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending a message with agent context.

classes.name: AgentWaitParams
classes.description: Parameters to wait for agent events.

classes.name: WakeParams
classes.description: Parameters to wake or activate a node.

classes.name: NodePairApproveParams
classes.description: Parameters to approve a node pairing request.

classes.name: NodePairRejectParams
classes.description: Parameters to reject a node pairing request.

classes.name: NodePairVerifyParams
classes.description: Parameters to verify a node pairing with a token.

classes.name: NodePendingAckParams
classes.description: Parameters for acknowledging pending node actions.

classes.name: NodeInvokeParams
classes.description: Parameters for invoking a command on a node.

classes.name: NodeInvokeResultParams
classes.description: Results from invoking a command on a node.

classes.name: NodeEventParams
classes.description: Parameters for triggering a node event.

classes.name: NodePendingEnqueueParams
classes.description: Parameters for enqueuing tasks on a node.

classes.name: NodeInvokeRequestEvent
classes.description: Event structure for invoking node commands.

classes.name: SessionsSendParams
classes.description: Parameters for sending a message in a session.

classes.name: SessionsMessagesSubscribeParams
classes.description: Parameters to subscribe to session messages.

classes.name: SessionsMessagesUnsubscribeParams
classes.description: Parameters to unsubscribe from session messages.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaLookupParams
classes.description: Parameters to lookup specific config schema info.

classes.name: WizardStartParams
classes.description: Parameters to start a wizard session.

classes.name: WizardCancelParams
classes.description: Parameters to cancel a wizard session.

classes.name: WizardNextResult
classes.description: Result returned after a wizard step.

classes.name: WizardStatusResult
classes.description: Status information for a wizard session.

classes.name: WebLoginStartParams
classes.description: Parameters to start web login process.

classes.name: WebLoginWaitParams
classes.description: Parameters to wait for web login.

classes.name: AgentsCreateParams
classes.description: Parameters to create a new agent.

classes.name: AgentsFileEntry
classes.description: Details of a file associated with an agent.

classes.name: AgentsFilesGetParams
classes.description: Parameters to get agent file content.

classes.name: AgentsListResult
classes.description: List of agents with summary info.
